= e |health = 150 |defense = 210 }} The stats of each piece are multiplied by {{DarkPurple|2x}} in {{zone|The End}}. This affect base stats, [[Reforging|Reforges]], [[Enchantments]], {{Item|Hot Potato Book}}s, {{Item|Fuming Potato Book}}s, etc.
A Minimum of {{Skill|Combat|12}} is required to use this set. A {{Item|Void Sword}} can be used with '''Ender Armor''' to gain up to {{Stat|str|+160}} whilst wearing all '''Ender Armor''' and [[Equipment]] pieces. == Tips == *All pieces of the '''Ender Armor''' set can be sold to any NPC for a price of {{c|10k}}, making collecting the armor pieces and selling them an effective early game money making method, especially when paired with mining [[Ender Nodes]] for {{Item|Mite Gel}}. *The set is recommended for the early-game due to its high damage and the fact that most early-game players will spend a lot of time in {{zone|The End}}. *Reforging the Armor to {{reforge|Fierce}} will buff the player's {{stat|crit damage}} and {{stat|crit chance}} immensely. *Ender Armor is often used alongside a {{Item|Raider Sword}}, an {{Item|Aspect of the End}}, or a {{Item|Void Sword}}. *Reforging the Equipment to Stained, Honored or Blended will give the player a sizeable increase in {{stat|crit chance}}. == Trivia == *Before the {{Item|Final Destination Armor}} was buffed on [https://hypixel.net/threads/february-2nd-balancing-patch.4778815/ February 2, 2022], some players would use '''Ender Armor''' against the {{MobSprite|Voidgloom Seraph}} due to the stats multiplier applying to reforges such as {{Reforge|Ancient}}. == History == {{History table |beta= {{History|2019/August 2|[[File: Ender Armor.png|26px]] Added '''Ender Armor'''.}}
